channel.title: Rochdale Daily
channel.description: Independent local news, public-service information and reporting from Rochdale borough.

item.title: Are there really fairies in Healey Dell?
item.description: The rocky cleft known as the Fairies’ Chapel is a real landscape feature with a long history of local storytelling — but the supernatural claims rest in folklore, not in official records.

item.title: Heights Lane Roadworks Scheduled from 26 October 2026
item.description: Heights Lane in Rochdale will be temporarily closed for roadworks from 26 October to 1 November 2026, affecting local traffic routes.

item.title: Dajaune Brown Scores First Goal for Rochdale AFC on Derby Day
item.description: Rochdale AFC secured a 2-0 victory over Oldham Athletic in a League Two derby match at Spotland on 19 September 2026, marking a strong start to the season for the home side.

item.title: Heywood Community Gala Photos Spark Comparisons to Glasgow's Willy Wonka Experience
item.description: The Heywood Community Gala, held from 18 to 20 September at The Pig and Whistle, has faced criticism after photos revealed a much smaller event than advertised, prompting comparisons to a controversial Glasgow experience.

item.title: St Luke’s Church in Deeplish to Host Outdoor Service on September 20
item.description: St Luke’s Church in Deeplish will host an outdoor service on September 20 at 10.30am, followed by refreshments. A new youth group, Roots, will also start on September 20.

item.title: Micky Mellon Praises Oldham-Rochdale Derby as a Thrilling Rivalry
item.description: Oldham Athletic manager Micky Mellon has described the upcoming derby against Rochdale as a ‘cracking’ fixture, highlighting its significance to both clubs and their supporters.

item.title: Rochdale Borough Council Launches Resilient Roch Flood Resilience Programme
item.description: The Resilient Roch programme aims to enhance flood resilience in vulnerable communities across Rochdale, focusing on building trust and partnerships to address climate risks.

item.title: Why does Rochdale say 'cruckle'?
item.description: A short guide to the local verb 'cruckle' — what it means, where it comes from, and why Rochdale people still claim it as their own.

item.title: Rochdale AFC U18 Transfers Update as of September 2026
item.description: Rochdale AFC U18 has made significant transfers this month, reflecting the club's commitment to youth development and competitive performance.

item.title: Rochdale AFC to Face Accrington Stanley in League Two Match on September 18, 2026
item.description: Rochdale AFC will compete against Accrington Stanley in a League Two fixture at Wham Stadium, with live updates available for fans unable to attend.

item.title: Rochdale FC Transactions Update Available on Yahoo Sports
item.description: Fans can find the latest updates on Rochdale FC's transactions, including player movements and team performance, on Yahoo Sports. The page provides comprehensive information for supporters.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Announces Admission Details for Tranmere Away Match
item.description: Rochdale AFC has released admission details for their away match against Tranmere Rovers, encouraging fans to check the club's website for ticket information.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Youth Team to Compete in U17 PDL Cup
item.description: Rochdale AFC's Youth Team will participate in the Premier League Under-17 Professional Development League Cup this season, marking an important opportunity for young players.

item.title: Ofsted Inspection Report Published for Tooth, Jessica Lena in Rochdale
item.description: Ofsted has released a new inspection report for Tooth, Jessica Lena, detailing the findings and rating awarded during the recent inspection conducted on 18 September 2026.

item.title: Rochdale MP Paul Waugh Highlights Local Achievements as Minister for Early Education
item.description: Paul Waugh, Rochdale's MP, reflects on his new role as Minister for Early Education and its impact on local initiatives, including the Holiday Activities and Food programme and the £20m Pride in Place fund.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Secures 2-0 Victory Against Oldham Athletic
item.description: Rochdale AFC moved off the bottom of the League Two table with a 2-0 win against Oldham Athletic in a closely contested Greater Manchester derby on Saturday, September 19, 2026.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Player Statistics Now Available on Transfermarkt
item.description: Fans can access detailed player statistics and transfer information for Rochdale AFC on Transfermarkt, enhancing their understanding of the club's performance.

item.title: Boy, 13, stabbed in Rochdale town centre: six arrested, two bailed and stop-and-search powers extended
item.description: Live story. Six teenage boys have now been arrested after a 13-year-old was stabbed in Rochdale town centre on Saturday night. Two have been released on bail, four remain in custody, and Section 60 stop-and-search powers in the town centre run until 3pm on Tuesday. Updated as Greater Manchester Police confirm developments.

item.title: Milnrow's John Milne Table Table to close on September 3
item.description: John Milne Table Table in Milnrow will close on 3 September, with the restaurant thanking generations of customers for their support and inviting guests to visit once more.

item.title: One in seven Rochdale businesses could be overpaying business rates, research claims
item.description: More than 1,300 commercial properties in Rochdale could be paying too much in business rates, with potential overpayments worth a combined £2.9 million a year, according to BusinessRateChecker.com.

item.title: REFORM UK DELIVERS: PEOPLE POWER BACKED BY REFORM SCRAPS DISASTROUS ROAD CLOSURES!
item.description: Heywood Township councillors have voted unanimously to end the Hopwood Triangle traffic trial after sustained opposition from residents, while the Coronation Avenue HGV parking restriction will remain.

item.title: From teaching assistant to PT: how Rochdale mum Jen Daker found the strongest version of herself
item.description: After 16 years in education, mum-of-two Jen Daker has found a new calling as a personal trainer at The Hybrid Hut in Rochdale, combining 4am discipline, family life and a passion for helping others build confidence.

item.title: Oliver Coldman crowned champion golfer at Rochdale Golf Club Captain’s Final
item.description: Oliver Coldman has won Rochdale Golf Club’s 2026 Captain’s Final with a two-round total of 133, four shots ahead of runner-up Steve Royle.

item.title: New HALO Hair & Beauty salon to open on Shawclough Road
item.description: HALO Hair & Beauty is preparing to open at 34a Shawclough Road on 1 September, with appointments already available to book and the new salon showcasing its first treatments.

item.title: Rochdale AFC installs 26 male sanitary bins to support fans after prostate cancer treatment
item.description: Rochdale AFC has installed 26 specially designed male incontinence bins at the Crown Oil Arena and joined Prostate Cancer UK and phs Group's BOG STANDARD Charter through the Back in the Game campaign.

item.title: Rock Classics by Candlelight, Rochdale
item.description: 🎻 Strings of Fire — a classical string quartet like you’ve never seen before! Blending stunning strings with rock classics, electro sounds and high-energy performance, this is classical music with attitude. All in the stunning setting of Rochdale Town Hall 🔥🤘 Rochdale, Town Hall, The Esplanade, Rochdale OL16 1AZ, UK

item.title: WellMental UK hosts first men's mental health fitness session in Heywood
item.description: WellMental UK held its first session in Heywood on Friday evening, combining fitness, food and conversation to support men's mental health.

item.title: Norden Cricket Club festival brings community together today
item.description: Norden Cricket Club's festival has been taking place today, with Rochdale Daily wishing everyone attending a fantastic evening of entertainment.

item.title: Driver arrested after stolen vehicle recovered on Milnrow Road in Rochdale
item.description: A driver has been arrested after Rochdale neighbourhood officers stopped a vehicle on Milnrow Road that police say had been reported stolen from North Wales.

item.title: Rochdale Foodbank appeals for this week's most-needed items
item.description: Rochdale Foodbank is asking residents to donate Tampax, rice, noodles, juice and snacks as part of its latest weekly appeal.

item.title: Wildfire emergency alert: an overreaction, or a sign of things to come?
item.description: Millions of phones across England and Wales sounded a Government Emergency Alert as wildfire risk reached exceptional levels. Was the intrusive warning proportionate, or are Britons being introduced to a hazard we will increasingly have to live with?

item.title: Homelessness, addiction and the cruelty of public condemnation
item.description: A disabled homeless man outside Tesco Express on Whitworth Road has become the subject of photographs, insults and jokes online. The harder question is whether public humiliation solves anything at all.

item.title: URGENT: Police appeal to find missing 10-year-old Rayah in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police has launched an urgent appeal to find 10-year-old Rayah, who was last seen on Bower Avenue in Rochdale at around 8.30am today.

item.title: Rochdale businesses urged to back Denehurst House in £30-a-month veterans challenge
item.description: A Rochdale veterans support organisation is asking 100 local businesses to pledge £30 a month to help keep Denehurst House operational and support former service personnel in need.

item.title: Rochdale AFC Netball launched as Rochdale Netball Club joins Dale family
item.description: Rochdale Netball Club is becoming Rochdale AFC Netball in a new partnership with Rochdale AFC and its Community Trust, bringing nearly 200 weekly players into the club's wider sporting family.

item.title: LIVE: Murder ruled out as investigation continues into death of Nathan Haigh in Rochdale
item.description: Greater Manchester Police has ruled out murder as a line of enquiry into the death of 31-year-old Nathan Haigh at Great Howarth, while enquiries into the circumstances continue.

item.title: A-Level results day: Rochdale students discover what comes next
item.description: Students across Rochdale are receiving their A-Level results today, as the town's sixth form record comes under the spotlight and Rochdale MP Paul Waugh begins his new role at the Department for Education.

item.title: No trains between Rochdale and Manchester Victoria this week as replacement buses run
item.description: Passengers travelling between Rochdale and Manchester Victoria are being advised to allow extra time this week, with trains replaced by buses from Monday 10 to Friday 14 August.

item.title: £12m plan aims to bring Storage World Middleton site back to life after devastating fire
item.description: A £12m rebirth bid has been launched for the Storage World site in Middleton, more than a year after a devastating fire destroyed the Old Hall Street facility.

item.title: Summer makeover under way at St Mary’s CE Primary School in Rochdale
item.description: St Mary’s CE Primary School in Rochdale is undergoing a summer makeover, with improvement works taking place in the school hall and reception classroom ahead of the new term.

item.title: Can’t make it to church? Christ Church Healey invites community to join Sunday service online
item.description: Christ Church Healey is inviting people who cannot attend in person, are new to church or simply want to find out more to join its Sunday morning service online each week.

item.title: New Greater Manchester Mayor Bev Craig visits Rochdale
item.description: Newly elected Greater Manchester Mayor Bev Craig is visiting Rochdale today as she begins work across the city-region following her victory in last month's mayoral by-election.

item.title: LIVE: GMP student officer arrested on suspicion of rape and kidnap after M62 pursuit
item.description: LIVE updates after a 23-year-old Greater Manchester Police student officer was arrested on suspicion of rape, kidnap and dangerous driving following a pursuit on the M62.

item.title: Littleborough residents help boost flood resilience through Resilient Roch project
item.description: Residents at Olive Standring House in Littleborough have joined housing, council and Environment Agency teams to refresh planters while highlighting ongoing flood-resilience work across the borough.

item.title: Step inside the 'other side' of Rochdale Town Hall with guided Court Chamber tours
item.description: Visitors are being invited inside Rochdale Town Hall's lavishly decorated Historic Court Chamber as guided tours reveal one of the building's lesser-seen restored spaces.

item.title: MBF Cleaning sponsors Rochdale Foodbank van to support deliveries across the borough
item.description: MBF Cleaning has agreed to sponsor Rochdale Foodbank's van, helping the charity collect supplies and deliver food parcels to distribution points around the borough.

item.title: This week in Rochdale, 100 years ago: the town captured from the air in August 1926
item.description: Exactly a century ago this month, aerial photographers captured remarkable views of Rochdale's Town Hall, Yorkshire Street, railway station, Broadfield Park and industrial works — preserving the town as it looked in August 1926.

item.title: Are our reservoirs recovering after Rochdale's exceptionally dry summer?
item.description: North West reservoir stocks fell sharply during July, but the latest verified figures show the region entered the dry spell with considerably more water in storage than at the same point last year.

item.title: Little'Pink'borough returns as businesses across Littleborough prepare to turn pink for Cancer Research UK
item.description: Businesses and organisations across Littleborough, Hollingworth Lake and Wardle are being invited to take part in Little'Pink'borough, a community campaign raising awareness and funds for Cancer Research UK.

item.title: Inside abandoned Simpson Clough Paper Mill — and why urban exploration carries serious risks
item.description: A YouTube video has taken viewers inside the abandoned Simpson Clough Paper Mill near Rochdale, revealing remnants of its industrial past while highlighting the fascination — and dangers — of urban exploration.
